40022355.author: पदार्थः
40022355.content: तं him, शयानं lying down, नरव्याघ्रं tiger among men (best of men), निद्रा sleep, न not, अभ्यागमत् came, तदा then, चिन्तयन्तम् thinking, अनेकार्थं having many meanings, रामगीतम् song of Rama, अनुत्तमम् excellent.

40022355.author: Translation
40022355.content: At that time, sleep did not come to the best of men, Shatrughna, as he lay thinking about the excellent song of Rama, which had many meanings.

40022356.author: पदार्थः
40022356.content: तस्य his, शब्दं sound (singing), सुमधुरं very sweet, तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् accompanied by string instruments and rhythm, श्रुत्वा having heard, रात्रिः night, जगाम passed, आशु quickly, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, महात्मनः of the great-souled.

40022356.author: Translation
40022356.content: Having heard his (Lava's and Kusha's) very sweet singing, accompanied by string instruments and rhythm, the night quickly passed for the great-souled Shatrughna.

40022357.author: पदार्थः
40022357.content: तस्यां in that, निशायां night, व्युष्टायां having dawned, कृत्वा having performed, पौर्वाह्णिकं morning, क्रमम् rituals, उवाच spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यं words, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, मुनिपुङ्गवम् to the chief of sages (Valmiki).

40022357.author: Translation
40022357.content: When that night had dawned, Shatrughna, having performed his morning rituals, spoke words with folded hands to the chief of sages, Valmiki.

40022358.author: पदार्थः
40022358.content: भगवन् O venerable one, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I wish, राघवं Rama, रघुनन्दनम् delight of the Raghus, त्वया by you, अनुज्ञातुम् to be permitted, इच्छामि I wish, सह with, एभिः these, संशितव्रतैः those of firm vows.

40022358.author: Translation
40022358.content: Shatrughna said, "O venerable one, I wish to see Rama, the delight of the Raghus, and I wish to be permitted by you to go with these ascetics of firm vows."

40022359.author: पदार्थः
40022359.content: इति thus, एवंवादिनं speaking, तं him, तु indeed, शत्रुघ्नं Shatrughna, शत्रुतापनम् tormentor of foes, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, सम्परिष्वज्य having embraced, विससर्ज sent off, च and, राघवम् to Rama.

40022359.author: Translation
40022359.content: Having embraced Shatrughna, the tormentor of foes, who was speaking thus, Valmiki sent him off to Rama.

40022360.author: पदार्थः
40022360.content: सः He, अभिवाद्य having saluted, मुनिश्रेष्ठम् the best of sages, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य having ascended, सुप्रभम् resplendent, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, अगमत् went, तूर्णं quickly, राघवोत्सुकदर्शनः eager to see Rama

40022360.author: Translation
40022360.content: Having saluted the revered sage Valmiki and mounted his splendid chariot, he swiftly departed for Ayodhya, eager to behold Rama.

40022361.author: पदार्थः
40022361.content: सः He, प्रविष्टः having entered, पुरीं city, रम्यां beautiful, श्रीमान् glorious, इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः delight of the Ikshvakus, प्रविवेश entered, महाबाहुः mighty-armed, यत्र where, रामः Rama, महाद्युतिः highly effulgent

40022361.author: Translation
40022361.content: The glorious and mighty-armed Shatrughna, the delight of the Ikshvakus, entered the beautiful city and proceeded to where the highly effulgent Rama resided.

40022362.author: पदार्थः
40022362.content: सः He, रामं Rama, मन्त्रिमध्यस्थं seated amidst ministers, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननम् with a face like the full moon, पश्यन् seeing, अमरमध्यस्थं seated amidst gods, सहस्रनयनं thousand-eyed, यथा like

40022362.author: Translation
40022362.content: He saw Rama, whose face resembled the full moon, seated amidst his ministers, appearing like the thousand-eyed Indra surrounded by gods.

40022363.author: पदार्थः
40022363.content: सः He, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानं the great-souled one, ज्वलन्तम् shining, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor, उवाच spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यं words, रामं to Rama, सत्यपराक्रमम् of true valor

40022363.author: Translation
40022363.content: Having saluted the great-souled Rama, who shone as if with his own splendor and possessed true valor, he spoke with folded hands.

40022364.author: पदार्थः
40022364.content: यत् whatever, आज्ञप्तं commanded, महाराज O great king, सर्वं all, तत् that, कृतवान् have done, अहम् I, हतः killed, सः that, लवणः Lavana, पापः wicked, पुरी city, च and, अस्य his, निवेशिता established

40022364.author: Translation
40022364.content: O great king, I have accomplished all that you commanded: the wicked Lavana has been slain, and his city has been established.

40022365.author: पदार्थः
40022365.content: द्वादशैते these twelve, गता passed, वर्षास् years, त्वाम् you, विना without, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, न not, उत्सहेयम् I am able, अहम् I, वस्तुम् to live, त्वया by you, विरहितो separated, नृप O King

40022365.author: Translation
40022365.content: O Rama, twelve years have passed without you, and I, separated from you, O King, am no longer able to live here.

40022366.author: पदार्थः
40022366.content: स therefore, मे to me, प्रसादम् favor, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, कुरुष्व grant, अमितविक्रम O one of immeasurable valor, मातृहीनः motherless, यथा as, वत्सः a calf, न not, चिरम् long, प्रवसामि I can stay away, अहम् I

40022366.author: Translation
40022366.content: Therefore, O Rama of immeasurable valor, grant me this favor, for I cannot stay away much longer, just like a motherless calf.

40022367.author: पदार्थः
40022367.content: एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, परिष्वज्य having embraced, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् he said, मा do not, विषादम् sorrow, कृथाः do, शूर O brave one, न not, एतत् this, क्षत्रियचेष्टितम् conduct of a Kshatriya

40022367.author: Translation
40022367.content: Having embraced Shatrughna who was speaking thus, Rama said, "O brave one, do not despair, for this is not the conduct befitting a Kshatriya."

40022368.author: पदार्थः
40022368.content: न not, अवसीदन्ति become dejected, राजानो kings, विप्रवासेषु in separations, राघव O Raghava, प्रजा subjects, नः by us, परिपाल्या to be protected, हि indeed, क्षत्रधर्मेण by the duty of a Kshatriya, राघव O Raghava

40022368.author: Translation
40022368.content: O Raghava, kings do not become dejected during separations, for indeed, our subjects must be protected according to the duty of a Kshatriya.

40022369.author: पदार्थः
40022369.content: काले काले from time to time, तु and, माम् me, वीर O brave one, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, अवलोकितुम् to see, आगच्छ come, त्वम् you, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, गन्तासि you will go, च and, पुरम् city, तव your

40022369.author: Translation
40022369.content: O brave one, O best among men, you should come to Ayodhya from time to time to see me, and you will also return to your own city.

40022370.author: पदार्थः
40022370.content: ममापि my also, त्वं you, सुदयितः very dear, प्राणैरपि even than life, न no, संशयः doubt, अवश्यं certainly, करणीयं to be done, च and, राज्यस्य of the kingdom, परिपालनम् protection

40022370.author: Translation
40022370.content: Rama tells Shatrughna that he is dearer than life itself, but the protection of the kingdom is an essential duty.

40022371.author: पदार्थः
40022371.content: तस्मात् therefore, त्वं you, वस stay, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, सप्तरात्रम् for seven nights, इह here, आवस stay, ऊर्ध्वं thereafter, गन्तासि you will go, मधुरां to Mathura, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with servants, army, and vehicles

40022371.author: Translation
40022371.content: Therefore, O Kakutstha, stay here for seven nights, and thereafter you shall proceed to Mathura with your servants, army, and vehicles.

40022372.author: पदार्थः
40022372.content: रामस्य of Rama, एतत् this, वचः word, श्रुत्वा having heard, धर्मयुक्तं righteous, मनोगतम् heartfelt, शत्रुघ्नो Shatrughna, दीनया with a humble, वाचा voice, बाढम् indeed, इति thus, एव only, च and, अब्रवीत् spoke

40022372.author: Translation
40022372.content: Having heard these righteous and heartfelt words of Rama, Shatrughna, with a humble voice, simply replied, "Indeed."

40022373.author: पदार्थः
40022373.content: सप्तरात्रं for seven nights, च and, काकुत्स्थो Kakutstha, राघवस्य of Rama, यथाज्ञया as per the command, उष्य having stayed, तत्र there, महेष्वासो the great archer, गमनाय for departure, उपचक्रमे began

40022373.author: Translation
40022373.content: And the great archer Shatrughna, having stayed there for seven nights as per Rama's command, began preparations for his departure.

40022374.author: पदार्थः
40022374.content: आमन्त्र्य having bid farewell to, तु indeed, महात्मानं the great-souled, रामं Rama, सत्यपराक्रमम् of true valor, भरतं Bharata, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, च and, एव also, महारथम् a great chariot, उपारुहत् ascended

40022374.author: Translation
40022374.content: Having bid farewell to the great-souled Rama of true valor, and also to Bharata and Lakshmana, he then ascended a great chariot.

40022375.author: पदार्थः
40022375.content: दूरम् far, आभ्याम् by both, अनुगतः followed, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, महात्मना by the great-souled, भरतेन by Bharata, च and, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, जगाम went, आशु quickly, पुरम् to the city, ततः then.

40022375.author: Translation
40022375.content: After being accompanied for a long distance by the great-souled Lakshmana and Bharata, Shatrughna then quickly proceeded to the city of Ayodhya. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 72 ।। Thus ends the seventy-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
